candidates.label: Shift each character one key left on its QWERTY row via a lookup table; preserves exact line structure and spacing via getline.
Shift map built backwards (maps each char to the one AFTER it instead of before) -- unambiguously wrong direction, should fail even the existing sample.

Reads word-by-word via cin>> instead of getline, collapsing multi-space runs to a single space and flattening multi-line input to one output line -- likely to pass a thin test suite that never exercises unusual spacing or multiple lines.
